meta.yardstick: A packaging consultant reviewing one release manifest bills by the hour; this reads the same file in under a second.

rules.title: No [project] table
rules.fix: Add a [project] table with name, version, requires-python and license.

rules.title: requires-python absent
rules.fix: Set requires-python so pip refuses interpreters you do not support.

rules.title: requires-python floor is end-of-life
rules.fix: Raise the floor to a version that still gets security fixes.

rules.title: requires-python floor goes end-of-life within a year
rules.fix: Plan the floor bump before that date, not after a CVE.

rules.title: Upper cap on requires-python
rules.fix: Drop the upper cap; a cap makes resolvers skip your package on new Python.

rules.title: Classifier advertises an end-of-life Python
rules.fix: Remove the classifier for that version.

rules.title: Classifier contradicts requires-python
rules.fix: Keep classifiers and requires-python on the same set of versions.

rules.title: license as a table is deprecated
License :: classifier is deprecated
rules.fix: Delete the License :: classifier; the SPDX expression carries it now.

rules.title: SPDX expression and License :: classifier together
rules.fix: Keep the SPDX expression, delete every License :: classifier.

rules.title: license-files pattern is not a relative glob
rules.fix: license-files patterns must be relative and must not contain '..'.

rules.title: license is not a valid SPDX identifier
rules.fix: Replace it with the current SPDX identifier.

rules.title: SPDX operator is lower-case
rules.fix: SPDX operators are AND, OR, WITH in upper case.

rules.title: setuptools pin cannot read the SPDX license field
rules.fix: Raise the build requirement to setuptools>=77.

rules.title: Field is both static and dynamic
rules.fix: A field listed in dynamic must not also be set statically.

rules.title: Distribution name is not in normalised form
rules.fix: Lower-case it and use hyphens so the name you publish is the name people type.

rules.title: No readme
rules.fix: Point readme at your README file so the PyPI page is not blank.

rules.title: No [project.urls]
rules.fix: Add Homepage / Source / Issues so the PyPI sidebar has links.
